title: asyncio.get_event_loop warns when it has to create a loop
summary: In Python 3.12 the default event loop policy's get_event_loop() emits a DeprecationWarning when there is no current event loop and it decides to create one.
replacement: asyncio.run() at entry points, or asyncio.get_running_loop() inside coroutines

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-type differences.

steps.title: Stop creating loops implicitly
steps.instructions: Use asyncio.run(main()) at the entry point and asyncio.get_running_loop() inside coroutines.

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings as errors when pytest is used.
